description.de: Umfassender 6-Dimensionen-Check: Build, Tests, Komplexität, Dependencies, Docs, Architektur → Scorecard
description.en: Comprehensive 6-dimension check: build, tests, complexity, dependencies, docs, architecture → scorecard

instructions: Du erstellst eine umfassende Gesundheits-Scorecard fuer das MySuricates-Projekt. Bewerte 6 Dimensionen jeweils 1-10. Sei objektiv und datengetrieben.

config.label: Backend Build + Tests
config.command:
cd /home/flo/Entwicklung/tools/autotrigger/ai-automation-backend

echo '=== Maven Build + Tests ==='
BUILD_OUTPUT=$(mvn clean package 2>&1)
MVN_EXIT=$?
echo "$BUILD_OUTPUT" | tail -30

echo ''
echo '--- Build-Ergebnis ---'
echo "Maven exit: $MVN_EXIT"
TESTS_RUN=$(echo "$BUILD_OUTPUT" | grep 'Tests run:' | tail -1)
echo "$TESTS_RUN"

if [ $MVN_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  echo 'BUILD_STATUS: FAILED'
else
  echo 'BUILD_STATUS: OK'
fi

config.label: Frontend Build + Lint
config.command:
cd /home/flo/Entwicklung/tools/autotrigger/ai-automation-frontend

echo '=== ESLint ==='
LINT_OUT=$(npm run lint 2>&1)
LINT_EXIT=$?
echo "$LINT_OUT" | tail -20
WARNINGS=$(echo "$LINT_OUT" | grep -c 'warning' || true)
ERRORS=$(echo "$LINT_OUT" | grep -c 'error' || true)
echo "Lint: exit=$LINT_EXIT, warnings=$WARNINGS, errors=$ERRORS"

echo ''
echo '=== Vite Build ==='
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -10
BUILD_EXIT=$?
echo "Build exit: $BUILD_EXIT"

if [ $LINT_EXIT -ne 0 ] || [ $BUILD_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  echo 'FRONTEND_STATUS: FAILED'
else
  echo 'FRONTEND_STATUS: OK'
fi

config.label: Projekt-Metriken sammeln
config.command:
set -euo pipefail
BASE=/home/flo/Entwicklung/tools/autotrigger

echo '=== Code-Statistiken ==='
echo '--- Backend Java ---'
find "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/main/java" -name '*.java' | wc -l
find "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/main/java" -name '*.java' -exec cat {} + | wc -l
echo '--- Backend Tests ---'
find "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/test/java" -name '*.java' 2>/dev/null | wc -l
echo '--- Frontend TS/TSX ---'
find "$BASE/ai-automation-frontend/src" \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | wc -l
find "$BASE/ai-automation-frontend/src" \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec cat {} + | wc -l

echo ''
echo '=== Grosse Dateien (>300 LOC) ==='
find "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/main/java" -name '*.java' | while read f; do
  l=$(wc -l < "$f")
  [ "$l" -gt 300 ] && echo "$l $(basename $f .java)"
done | sort -rn | head -10
find "$BASE/ai-automation-frontend/src" \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | while read f; do
  l=$(wc -l < "$f")
  [ "$l" -gt 300 ] && echo "$l $(echo $f | sed "s|$BASE/ai-automation-frontend/src/||")"
done | sort -rn | head -10

echo ''
echo '=== Test-Coverage-Ratio ==='
SRC=$(find "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/main/java" -name '*.java' | wc -l)
TST=$(find "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/test/java" -name '*Test*.java' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "Backend: $TST tests / $SRC sources = $(python3 -c "print(f'{$TST/$SRC*100:.1f}%' if $SRC>0 else '0%')")"

echo ''
echo '=== TODO/FIXME im Code ==='
grep -rn 'TODO\|FIXME\|HACK\|XXX' --include='*.java' --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/main" "$BASE/ai-automation-frontend/src" 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | wc -l
grep -rn 'TODO\|FIXME' --include='*.java' --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/main" "$BASE/ai-automation-frontend/src" 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -15

echo ''
echo '=== Git-Statistiken (letzte 14 Tage) ==='
cd "$BASE"
git log --since='14 days ago' --oneline | wc -l
echo 'commits (14d)'
git log --since='14 days ago' --pretty=format:'%h %s' | head -10
echo ''
echo '--- Offene Branches ---'
git branch | wc -l

echo ''
echo '=== Dependencies ==='
echo '--- Maven (Backend) ---'
cd "$BASE/ai-automation-backend" && mvn dependency:list -DoutputAbsoluteArtifactFilename=false 2>/dev/null | grep ':.*:.*:' | wc -l || echo '?'
echo '--- npm (Frontend) ---'
cd "$BASE/ai-automation-frontend" && npm ls --depth=0 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo '?'

echo ''
echo '=== Flyway Migrations ==='
ls "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/" | sort | tail -5
ls "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/" | wc -l

config.label: Gesundheitsanalyse (Opus)
config.command:
Analysiere die Gesundheits-Metriken des MySuricates-Projekts und bewerte 6 Dimensionen:

DATEN:
{{ previous_output }}

Bewerte jede Dimension von 1 (kritisch) bis 10 (exzellent):

1. **Build-Stabilitaet** (Gewicht: 20%)
   - Backend-Build erfolgreich? Tests bestanden?
   - Frontend-Build + Lint sauber?
   - Scoring: 10=alles gruen, 7=warnings, 4=ein Build fehlschlaegt, 1=beides fehlschlaegt

2. **Test-Abdeckung** (Gewicht: 20%)
   - Test-to-Source-Ratio
   - Qualitaet der Tests (Anzahl @Test-Methoden, Vielfalt)
   - Scoring: 10=>70% Ratio + gute Tiefe, 7=40-70%, 4=20-40%, 1=<20%

3. **Code-Komplexitaet** (Gewicht: 15%)
   - Anzahl und Groesse von God Classes (>300 LOC)
   - TODO/FIXME-Dichte
   - Scoring: 10=keine God Classes, 7=1-3 grosse Files, 4=5+ grosse Files, 1=massive Komplexitaet

4. **Dependency-Gesundheit** (Gewicht: 15%)
   - Bekannte Vulnerabilities (npm audit)
   - Aktualitaet der Dependencies
   - Scoring: 10=keine CVEs + aktuell, 7=nur LOW CVEs, 4=HIGH CVEs, 1=CRITICAL CVEs

5. **Dokumentations-Aktualitaet** (Gewicht: 15%)
   - CLAUDE.md, WORKFLOW-GUIDE.md, architektur.md vorhanden und aktuell?
   - Scoring: 10=aktuell + vollstaendig, 7=vorhanden aber teils veraltet, 4=lueckenhaft, 1=fehlt

6. **Architektur-Sauberkeit** (Gewicht: 15%)
   - Schichtentrennung, Kopplung, zirkulaere Deps
   - Scoring: 10=sauber getrennt, 7=kleine Verbesserungen, 4=strukturelle Probleme, 1=Spaghetti

Gib fuer jede Dimension:
- Score (1-10)
- Begruendung (1-2 Saetze)
- Top-Verbesserung

Berechne den gewichteten Gesamtscore.

config.label: Gesundheits-Scorecard generieren
config.command:
Erstelle die MySuricates Gesundheits-Scorecard:

{{ previous_output }}

## Format:

### MySuricates Gesundheits-Scorecard

**Gesamtscore: X.X / 10** (Bewertung: EXZELLENT / GUT / AKZEPTABEL / VERBESSERUNGSBEDARF / KRITISCH)

| Dimension | Score | Trend | Handlungsbedarf |
|-----------|-------|-------|-----------------|
| Build-Stabilitaet | X/10 | - | - |
| Test-Abdeckung | X/10 | - | - |
| Code-Komplexitaet | X/10 | - | - |
| Dependency-Gesundheit | X/10 | - | - |
| Dokumentation | X/10 | - | - |
| Architektur | X/10 | - | - |

### Top-3 Handlungsempfehlungen
1. [Dringendste Massnahme]
2. [Zweitwichtigste]
3. [Drittwichtigste]

### Positive Highlights
- Was laeuft gut?

gate_status: GREEN wenn Gesamtscore > 7.0, YELLOW wenn 5.0-7.0, RED wenn < 5.0
gate_category: health-check
gate_description: MySuricates Gesamtscore X.X/10

config.label: Gate-Verdict
config.command:
PREV='{{ previous_output }}'

if echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: RED'; then
  echo 'Health Check: KRITISCH'
  echo 'gate_status: RED'
  echo 'gate_category: health-check'
  echo 'gate_description: MySuricates Gesundheit kritisch'
  exit 1
elif echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: YELLOW'; then
  echo 'Health Check: Verbesserungsbedarf'
  echo 'gate_status: YELLOW'
  echo 'gate_category: health-check'
  echo 'gate_description: MySuricates Gesundheit ausbaufaehig'
else
  echo 'Health Check: GUT'
  echo 'gate_status: GREEN'
  echo 'gate_category: health-check'
  echo 'gate_description: MySuricates Gesundheit gut'
fi
